title: The Lighthouse Keeper's Radio
synopsis: On a storm-battered island, an elderly lighthouse keeper discovers that her broken radio picks up the voices of ships lost decades ago, and must decide whether to answer a captain asking for a safe harbour.

title: Concrete Orchard
synopsis: Two rival teenagers on a Lisbon rooftop community garden fight a developer who plans to pave it over, learning that the garden's soil holds a secret buried by their grandparents.

title: Static Bloom
synopsis: An experimental essay about television snow, told through found footage and a single voiceover about a mother's last year of work at a broadcast tower.
